Core Audio Format demuxer (CafReader).

Ports symphonia-format-caf chunks/demuxer: caff header, chunk walk (desc/data/chan/pakt/kuki/free, unknown skipped), desc format IDs (lpcm incl. float/endianness, ulaw, alaw, alac via kuki magic cookie), chan layout tags + bitmap, pakt packet tables (all four CBR/VBR cases, priming/remainder recorded), fixed-packet chunking (1152 frames), variable-packet emission, floor packet-aligned seek. Deviations: in-memory with an eager packet index; info/strings metadata chunks are skipped (as in the reference); chan custom descriptions beyond L/R/C/LFE/RL/RR are ignored; the variable-seek slice-relative index quirk in the reference is implemented with the correct absolute index; strings chunks are skipped.
